_comment: Reviewed call sites for tests/Security.Tests.ps1: every .NET method call in src/ whose arguments use a whole-text variable ($T, $Text, $Raw, $inner, $Body, or a member with one of these names). PowerShell 7.3+ logs every .NET method call made from script with the full text of its string arguments, so such a call must run a bounded number of times per file, or receive a bounded text. A key is file | function | method; a call in a rule check is named 'rule <ID>'; static calls are written [Type]::Method. Each entry gives the exact count and the reason. 'Not a string' entries pass an object or an array, which the log shows by its type name only.

calls.why: Not a string: adds one new object per .codex/rules file; Raw is one of its properties.
Once per output format: writes the rendered report to its file.
Not a string: one hashtable per frontmatter line; $raw is that line.
Per frontmatter line: $raw is one line, and the frontmatter is cut to AwYamlMaxChars characters first, so the total stays bounded.
Per multi-line plain scalar: $text is the value of one frontmatter line, inside the AwYamlMaxChars cut.
Per scalar or continuation line: $Text is one frontmatter value, inside the AwYamlMaxChars cut.
Once per parse: the token regex starts on the whole text, then the loop moves on with NextMatch(), which takes no argument.
Per string token with a backslash: $inner is that one token, so the total stays linear in the file size.
Per untrusted pattern and tested value: $Text is a setting value or a command string, not a file text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field or an error message, not a file text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field or an error message, not a file text.
Per finding field or error message: $Text is short evidence or a message, not a file text.
Per finding field or error message: $Text is short evidence or a message, not a file text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field or an error message, not a file text.
Not a string: $raw is a category score (a number), once per category.
Error path: runs once, inside the throw that ends the parse.
Per multi-line string token: $raw is that one token, so the total stays linear in the file size.
Per string token: $raw is that one token, so the total stays linear in the file size.
Not a string: joins the array of segment texts of one console line.
Once per report: $body is the fixed body.html template of the tool, not scanned content.
Twice per report: hashes the inline style and the inline script for the Content-Security-Policy.
Per JSON value: $inner is the indentation (a line break and two spaces per level), not a text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field (title, evidence, key, fix), not a file text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field (title, evidence, key, fix), not a file text.
Per output field: $Text is a finding field or a rule description, not a file text.
Once per agent file and bypass pattern (a fixed list); the loop moves on with NextMatch().
Once per agent file; the loop moves on with NextMatch().
Once per frontmatter key lookup: each frontmatter rule looks up one key per agent file, so the count per file is fixed.
Called once by each Find-AwAgtKeyLine lookup, so the count per agent file is fixed.
Per finding: AW-AGT-007 passes the whole file text once per reported line (at most AwAgtMaxFindingsPerFile per file), AW-AGT-009 once per file. Testing $Text.Length instead would remove it.
Per evidence text, which Protect-AwAgtEvidence cuts to about 4,600 characters first; one pass per secret pattern (a fixed list).
Per evidence text, which Protect-AwAgtEvidence cuts to about 4,600 characters first.
Per surrogate pair of one evidence text, after the cut to 4,608 characters: bounded, but inside a loop. Appending $Text.Substring($i, 2) would remove it.
Per evidence, before the cut: for AW-AGT-008 this is one HTML comment, and the comments of a file share the AwAgtMaxDirectiveChars budget.
Per HTML comment: $Text is one comment, and the comments tested per file share the AwAgtMaxDirectiveChars budget.
Once per CLAUDE.md file: finds the code fences.

Once per agent file; the loop moves on with NextMatch().
